desc: Derive the fixed-\(H\) feasible interval for each upper tooth and the cost formula.
Derive the \(O(N)\) interval-propagation feasibility check for the adjacent-difference constraint.
Justify monotonic feasibility in \(H\), enabling binary search.
Implement binary search over \(0 \le H \le \min_i(U_i+D_i)\) and compute the minimum grinding cost.
Prepare the final Python stdin/stdout solution enclosed in the requested code delimiters.
